subtitle: Serracapriola — Province of Foggia
description: A medieval village in the heart of the Northern Apennines of Daunia, rich in history, art and traditions. Use the menu below to discover everything the town has to offer.
corsoText1: There are places you visit and others you truly live. Serracapriola is one of them — nestled on a hill that overlooks the Tavoliere plain. This charming Apulian village captures the hearts of all who walk its streets, with the allure of its ancient stones, the warmth of its people, and the aromas of its culinary traditions.
corsoText2: Strolling through the streets of the historic centre and along Corso Garibaldi means stepping back in time, where every alley, every palazzo, and every viewpoint holds stories of a past that continues to live in the present. Here, the rhythm of life invites you to slow down, admire the scenery, and let yourself be wrapped in an atmosphere of warmth and hospitality.
corsoText3: Welcome to Serracapriola... a land that breathes Puglia, where every encounter becomes a memory and every emotion finds the flavour of tradition. We look forward to giving you an experience to carry in your heart.
